env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CC=
env CGO_ENABLED=0

# The wildcard cgo keep must judge a file by the content the build sees,
# not the content on disk. MatchFile reads overlaid replacements through
# cmd/go/internal/fsys; the import "C" probe must read them the same way.

# An overlay that removes import "C" while keeping the never-satisfied cgo
# constraint: the effective package uses no cgo, so ./... must skip it in
# silence, as the go command does for the overlaid content.
cd drop
logos build -overlay=overlay.json ./...
! stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
# The explicit path reports the excluded file like plain go does, not a
# cgo denial read from the replaced disk file.
! logos build -overlay=overlay.json ./c
stderr 'build constraints exclude all Go files'
cd ..

# The reverse: the overlay adds import "C" to an otherwise plain file. The
# effective package uses cgo, so ./... must deny it exactly like the
# explicit package path does.
cd add
! logos build -overlay=overlay.json ./...
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
! logos build -overlay=overlay.json ./c
stderr '\[restriction::cgo_usage\]'
cd ..

-- drop/go.mod --
module example.com/f06drop

go 1.27

-- drop/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- drop/c/c.lgo --
//go:build cgo

package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }

-- drop/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"c/c.lgo": "../repl/drop-c.lgo"
	}
}

-- add/go.mod --
module example.com/f06add

go 1.27

-- add/main.lgo --
package main

func main() {}

-- add/c/c.lgo --
package c

func One() int { return 1 }

-- add/overlay.json --
{
	"Replace": {
		"c/c.lgo": "../repl/add-c.lgo"
	}
}

-- repl/drop-c.lgo --
//go:build cgo

package c

func One() int { return 1 }

-- repl/add-c.lgo --
package c

// int one(void) { return 1; }
import "C"

func One() int { return int(C.one()) }
